page.overview:
Who is Zoe?

Zoe was a character in Five Days at Carthag.

Zoe was a smuggler based in Carthag who was part of a group with led by Stisk, which also included Valentin, Chingo and Maax. She and Stisk met with Valentin when he returned from poisoning Argus Veer and he informed them that calls had been made for their arrest on the Communinet Radio stations of both House Harkonnen and the Imperium, with 20 metre holograms of them displayed in the main concourse. Zoe wondered how they could be looking for them and Stisk insisted that the death of Veer would cause the locals to revolt and allow them to escape. Chingo and Maax then arrived after spreading the work of Veer's death. Stisk then revealed that she had blown their cover by falsely reporting the alcohol in the vault they had hit in Tsimpo as destroyed. Zoe and Valentin were angered that Stisk had made it so they could never return to their homes, as she was willing to sabotage her own people due to her vendetta against the Harkonnens.
